payload.title: Optional Linux implementation track
payload.summary: Four optional Linux-only labs connect the portable C17 course to selected Linux networking interfaces and implementation boundaries without making kernel internals a prerequisite.

prerequisites: Ubuntu or a comparable Linux environment
GCC or Clang, CMake 3.25 or newer, and CTest
No root access, namespace setup, virtual interface, packet capture, raw socket, or internet connection
outcomes: Use stable Linux user-space interfaces before studying internal implementation paths
Run deterministic, local, unprivileged tests for each optional lab
Recognize UAPI headers as contracts and internal kernel files as implementation references

items.label: epoll Event Loop
items.description: Readiness, framing, deadlines, and descriptor ownership.

items.label: TCP_INFO
items.description: Loopback TCP observation through versioned Linux UAPI data.

items.label: Userspace Mini-Stack
items.description: Deterministic routing, TCP, IPv4, Ethernet, and diagnostics over a local Unix socket pair.

items.label: Kernel Source Walkthrough
items.description: Authored ingress and egress reading paths through pinned Linux v6.6 source.

allowed: Deterministic buffers and ordinary unprivileged Linux APIs
Loopback with ephemeral ports when a socket is necessary
Pinned source links for study and provenance
excluded: Raw and packet sockets, packet-capture tools, process execution, and wildcard listeners
TUN/TAP devices, namespace or privilege-changing APIs, fork, clone, and external numeric endpoints
Copying Linux kernel source, comments, tables, or snapshots into this MIT-licensed repository
